rows.Bloom: Deep pink - violet. Strong fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), cupped, quartered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, upright. Medium, dark green foliage.

Height: 3' to 4' (90 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to blackspot .
